your_games.title: Palworld's boss would "love to have conversations" about a Switch 2 version
your_games.body: Pocketpair CEO Takuru Mizobe told VGC the Switch 2 is "a really amazing platform" and that the studio would welcome talks about bringing Palworld to Switch. There's a catch: Nintendo's patent lawsuit against Pocketpair is still going, and the Tokyo District Court is due to share its preliminary view on 9 Nov.

your_games.title: Nintendo Indie World showcase airs today at 16:00 SAST
your_games.body: Nintendo has announced a roughly 15-minute Indie World presentation for this afternoon, 14:00 UK time, which is 16:00 SAST. It's the second Indie World of the year, so expect a mix of new reveals and possibly a shadow-drop or two.

your_games.title: Conan Exiles Enhanced and Aloft are both heading to PS5 in early 2027
your_games.body: Funcom's Unreal Engine 5 remaster of its open-world survival game brings Nanite and Lumen visuals, better performance, quality-of-life fixes and a new UI. It's a free upgrade for PS4 owners, with DLC and Bazaar purchases carrying over. Its floating-islands survival-crafting game Aloft, in PC early access since January 2025, is getting a PS5 1.0 launch around the same time.

your_games.title: Minecraft is out now on Switch 2, with a discount for physical Switch owners
your_games.body: Digital Switch owners get the Switch 2 version free until the end of January 2027. If you own a physical Switch copy, you'll get an in-game message offering the digital Ultimate Collection (base game plus five add-ons) at a reduced price. The Switch 2 version supports Vibrant Visuals and includes the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack.

your_games.title: Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 update is live on Switch 2, but it's buggy
your_games.body: Update 2.5 brings mod support and dual-wielded pistols, but Switch 2 players are reporting crashes, loading bugs, performance problems and save glitches, and Nintendo Life confirmed some crashes itself. No word from CD Projekt Red on a fix yet.

your_games.title: GTA 6's reported PS5 install size is a monster
your_games.body: Going by a reliable PS5 file-size tracker on X, GTA 6 will take up roughly a third of a launch PS5's SSD. Pre-loading opens a week before the 19 Nov launch, so it's worth clearing space now.

your_games.title: Rumour: a batch of Capcom console classics is on the way
your_games.body: Korea's ratings board has classified a string of classic Capcom games, including Ghosts 'n Goblins, Captain Commando, Knights of the Round and The King of Dragons, which points to a new collection. Nothing announced yet.

industry.title: Microsoft offers voluntary redundancy to around 60,000 staff
industry.body: That's roughly a quarter of the company. The Voluntary Exit Offer covers eligible staff in Canada, India, the UK and the US, after heavy AI spending. It lands in a year when Xbox has already cut thousands of jobs and closed or sold studios, though Xbox boss Asha Sharma insists "Xbox is not for sale".

industry.title: Kingdom Come studio Warhorse hit by a cyberattack
industry.body: Warhorse confirmed unauthorised access to its systems and company data and is working with security specialists. It hasn't said what was taken. It comes less than a week after Capcom's Capcom ID data breach.

industry.title: Capcom: 92.4% of its sales are now digital
industry.body: Capcom's half-year results show only 7.6% of game sales came from physical copies, and it expects digital to pass 95% next quarter. Back-catalogue titles drove its best-ever first half, with Devil May Cry 5 outselling Onimusha: Way of the Sword last quarter.

industry.title: Street Fighter 5 pulled from sale and taken offline over a PHP security flaw
industry.body: Capcom has shut off online features for the PS4 and Steam versions and is suspending sales while it fixes vulnerabilities in the PHP language. Offline modes still work.
